# partiteai_memory_store (Data Source)

A memory store: what a mesh remembers, and the scopes that divide it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Resource identifier

### Read-Only

- `consolidate_interval_seconds` (Number) How often the facts of this store are queued into consolidation passes
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the resource was created
- `description` (String) Resource description
- `embedding_profile_id` (String) ID of the embedding profile this store writes its vectors with
- `extract_interval_seconds` (Number) How often the turns of this store are planned into extraction work
- `index_conversation_messages` (Boolean) Whether those turns are indexed and embedded as well as kept
- `ingest_conversations` (Boolean) Whether the turns of a conversation are written into this store as they are said
- `name` (String) Resource name
- `scopes` (Attributes List) The scopes of this store (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--scopes))
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the resource was last updated
- `user_name_tag_key` (String) The tag key whose value names whoever is not the agent

<a id="nestedatt--scopes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `scopes`

Read-Only:

- `consolidation_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the facts of this scope are folded into observations
- `consolidation_model_profile_id` (String) ID of the model profile consolidation runs on
- `consolidation_prompt` (String) Extra instructions for the consolidation call
- `description` (String) What this scope is for
- `extraction_enabled` (Boolean) Whether facts are taken out of the documents this scope reads
- `extraction_model_profile_id` (String) ID of the model profile extraction runs on
- `extraction_prompt` (String) Extra instructions for the extraction call
- `id` (String) Scope identifier
- `key` (String) The tag key that every record of this scope carries
- `kind` (String) SLICED keeps a memory of each value of the tag it matches apart. UNSLICED makes one memory of everything it matches.
- `match` (String) The tag key that selects the documents this scope reads
- `value` (String) What an UNSLICED scope writes under that key
